protocol_summary.paper_style_note: A prebuilt master stimulus video is played with ffplay for smooth synchronized audio-video playback. A generated SRT subtitle provides parent name-call cues while a continuous recorder tags frames using the master timeline.

touch_features.touch_force_note: Laptop/Pygame mouse input does not provide real touch force. On Android/iOS/tablet, replace pressure_value with device touch pressure if available.

gaze_silhouette_stimulus_results.silhouette_note: Uses actual social/nonsocial AOI rectangles from stimulus_schedule/video_test instead of coarse left/right gaze split.

paper_facing_forward_social_movies.note: Computed from frame-wise logs using face detected + eyes open + yaw/pitch/head steadiness. Paper uses eyes open + gaze near screen + steady face.

paper_facing_forward_nonsocial_movies.note: Computed from frame-wise logs using face detected + eyes open + yaw/pitch/head steadiness. Paper uses eyes open + gaze near screen + steady face.

paper_gaze_percent_social.note: Computed from frame-wise gaze points and schedule-defined social AOI side during mixed social/non-social stimulus.

paper_gaze_silhouette_score.note: Computed using clustering separation of frame-wise gaze points across left/right AOIs during mixed social/non-social stimulus.

paper_attention_to_speech.note: Computed from speech-attention stimulus using speaker-turn timestamps and frame-wise gaze side matching. It becomes stronger when real two-speaker videos and exact speaker-turn annotations are used.

paper_response_to_name_delay.note: Computed from three scheduled name-call events during movie stimuli using frame-wise head-turn/yaw response detection.

paper_response_to_name_proportion.note: Computed as responded name calls over total scheduled name calls, using frame-wise head-turn/yaw response detection.

paper_blink_rate_social_movies.note: Computed from frame-wise blink states during social movie segments.

paper_blink_rate_nonsocial_movies.note: Computed from frame-wise blink states during nonsocial movie segments.

paper_eyebrows_complexity_social_movies.note: Computed from frame-wise eyebrow signal complexity. Paper uses multiscale entropy of eyebrow landmark dynamics.

paper_eyebrows_complexity_nonsocial_movi.note: Computed from frame-wise eyebrow signal complexity. Paper uses multiscale entropy of eyebrow landmark dynamics.

paper_mouth_complexity_social_movies.note: Computed from frame-wise mouth-open signal complexity. Paper uses multiscale entropy of mouth landmark dynamics.

paper_mouth_complexity_nonsocial_movies.note: Computed from frame-wise mouth-open signal complexity. Paper uses multiscale entropy of mouth landmark dynamics.

paper_head_movement_social_movies.note: Computed from frame-wise head movement during social movie segments.

paper_head_movement_nonsocial_movies.note: Computed from frame-wise head movement during nonsocial movie segments.

paper_head_movement_complexity_social_mo.note: Computed from frame-wise head movement complexity. Paper uses multiscale entropy.

paper_head_movement_complexity_nonsocial.note: Computed from frame-wise head movement complexity. Paper uses multiscale entropy.

paper_head_movement_acceleration_social_.note: Computed from derivative-like frame-wise head movement acceleration during social movies.

paper_head_movement_acceleration_nonsoci.note: Computed from derivative-like frame-wise head movement acceleration during nonsocial movies.

paper_pop_the_bubbles_popping_rate.note: Computed as popped bubbles over total touches, matching the paper concept.

paper_pop_the_bubbles_accuracy_std.note: Computed as standard deviation of distance from touch position to nearest bubble center.

paper_pop_the_bubbles_average_touch_leng.note: Computed from mouse/touch path length during bubble interaction. On touchscreen this directly corresponds to finger trajectory length.

paper_pop_the_bubbles_average_applied_fo.note: Paper uses device touch force/kinetic information. Desktop mouse does not provide true force; Android/iOS/tablet implementation should use pressure/touch APIs when available.
